answer_1.quote: We evaluate our methods on five reasoning benchmarks using five open-weights LLMs. Results show that early stopping strategies substantially reduce token usage.
answer_1.outputs: Generated chain-of-thought reasoning traces and final answers

answer_2.quote: We report Accuracy (Acc.), average generated tokens (Tokens #), and token reduction (%) relative to the original model.

answer_4.quote: To assess this aspect, we conduct a manual evaluation of reasoning chains generated by R1-Qwen-32B on GPQA under the Learn-to-Stop setting. We categorize the early-stopped generations into Perfect Stop, Late Stop, Incorrect Stop, and Unfaithful but Correct Stop.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators categorize each early-stopped generation into one of four classes: Perfect Stop, Late Stop, Incorrect Stop, Unfaithful but Correct Stop.
